AFL++
entries.description: A superior fork to Google's AFL with more speed, more and better mutations, more and better instrumentation, and custom module support.

entries.name: Angora
entries.description: A mutation-based coverage guided fuzzer that increases branch coverage by solving path constraints without symbolic execution.

entries.name: ACTOR
entries.description: (2023) - An action-guided kernel fuzzing framework that generates inputs leveraging triggered actions and their temporal relationships.

entries.name: NTFuzz
entries.description: (2021) - A type-aware Windows kernel fuzzer that statically analyzes system binaries to infer system call types for more effective fuzzing.

entries.name: KRACE
entries.description: (2020) - A coverage-guided fuzzing framework that detects data races in kernel file systems by exploring concurrency through multi-threaded syscall sequences.

entries.name: Razzer
entries.description: (2019) - A kernel fuzzer that uses static analysis and two-phase fuzzing to detect race conditions and concurrency bugs in Linux kernels.

entries.name: Hydra
entries.description: (2019) - A fuzzing framework for automatically discovering semantic bugs in file systems using input mutators, feedback engines, and customizable checkers.

entries.name: Janus
entries.description: (2019) - A file system fuzzer that finds memory corruptions in Linux kernel file systems by mutating both filesystem images and syscall sequences simultaneously.

entries.name: DIFUZE
entries.description: (2017) - An interface-aware fuzzer for Linux kernel drivers that automatically recovers ioctl interfaces via LLVM analysis and generates targeted test cases.

entries.name: IMF
entries.description: (2017) - A kernel API fuzzer that leverages automated API model inference to discover vulnerabilities in macOS kernel APIs.

entries.name: kAFL
entries.description: (2017) - A hardware-assisted x86-64 VM kernel fuzzing framework with performant VM reloads for finding OS kernel vulnerabilities.

entries.name: syzkaller
entries.description: (2015) - An unsupervised coverage-guided kernel fuzzer supporting FreeBSD, Fuchsia, gVisor, Linux, NetBSD, OpenBSD, and Windows.

entries.name: Trinity
entries.description: (2012) - A Linux system call fuzzer that generates semi-intelligent random arguments to syscalls, including valid file descriptors, flags, and range-biased values.

entries.name: WuppieFuzz
entries.description: A coverage-guided REST API fuzzer developed on top of LibAFL.

entries.name: IvySyn
entries.description: A fully-automated framework for discovering memory error vulnerabilities in Deep Learning (DL) frameworks.

entries.name: MINER
entries.description: A REST API fuzzer that utilizes three data-driven designs working together to guide sequence generation, improve request generation quality, and capture unique errors caused by incorrect parameter usage.

entries.name: RestTestGen
entries.description: A robust tool and framework designed for automated black-box testing of RESTful web APIs.

entries.name: GraphFuzz
entries.description: An experimental framework for building structure-aware, library API fuzzers.

entries.name: Minerva
entries.description: A browser fuzzer augmented by API mod-ref relations, aiming to synthesize highly-relevant browser API invocations in each test case.

entries.name: FANS
entries.description: A fuzzing tool for Android native system services with four components: interface collector, interface model extractor, dependency inferer, and fuzzer engine.

entries.name: DifuzzRTL
entries.description: A differential fuzz testing approach for CPU verification.

entries.name: MorFuzz
entries.description: A generic RISC-V processor fuzzing framework that can efficiently detect software triggerable functional bugs.

entries.name: SpecFuzz
entries.description: A tool to enable fuzzing for Spectre vulnerabilities.

entries.name: Transynther
entries.description: Automatically generates and tests building blocks for Meltdown attacks with various faults and microcode assists.

entries.name: TEFuzz
entries.description: A tailored fuzzing-based framework to facilitate the detection and exploitation of template escape bugs.

entries.name: Witcher
entries.description: A web application fuzzer that utilizes mutational fuzzing to explore web applications and fault escalation to detect command and SQL injection vulnerabilities.

entries.name: CorbFuzz
entries.description: A state-aware fuzzer for generating as many responses from a web application as possible without need of setting up a database.

entries.name: Fluffy
entries.description: A multi-transaction differential fuzzer for finding consensus bugs in Ethereum.

entries.name: LOKI
entries.description: A Blockchain consensus protocol fuzzing framework that detects consensus memory related and logic bugs.

entries.name: Squirrel
entries.description: A fuzzer for database management systems (DBMSs).
